## What this part will cover

- Why low-biomass samples such as throat swabs are hit hardest by contamination.
- Why removing every taxon seen in a blank is too blunt.
- decontam's prevalence method (with blanks) and frequency method (with DNA concentration).
- Checking the pipeline against the known mock community.
